comment: The spline output is written at four times the point values rather than five, SPL.cpp:262, so it is quieter than the other two and can pass above 5V where the spline overshoots. With the Phs jack patched the module becomes a reader of the points at an outside phase, SPL.cpp:288-298, and the reset and pitch controls take no part.
